heading: Page builder
warning: Edits are saved as a separate draft. Publishing replaces the page body with these sections. Existing HTML stays public until you publish.
title: Title
drag: Drag to reorder; use Move up / Move down for keyboard
saved: Draft saved. The public page has not changed.
error: Could not save or preview. Check links and images, then retry.
conflict: The page was changed elsewhere. Your edits remain here. Copy them before reloading.
confirm_publish: Publish these sections and replace the current page body?
confirm_remove: Remove this section? You can undo this action.
empty: Choose a section to start building.
section: Drag to reorder, or use the move buttons
acknowledge: I understand publishing replaces the existing page body.
preview_error: Preview unavailable. Correct the fields or retry saving.
confirm_reset: Discard draft edits and restore the last published layout if available? A page without a published builder layout returns to an empty editor. The public page stays unchanged until you publish.
discarded: Draft reverted. Public content is unchanged.
feed_help: Includes the latest public published posts in the preview and live page.
import_error: Could not import this layout. Use valid GoRun layout JSON under 1 MiB with safe links. Your previous layout is unchanged.
scene_help: The secure preview shows the static shape; animation runs on the published page.
history_help: Saved and published layouts for this page. Preview opens a read-only snapshot. Restore replaces the private draft only; the public page stays unchanged until you publish. Restore asks for a recent password confirmation.
history_empty: No saved layout revisions yet. Save or publish to start history.
history_restore_lead: This replaces the current private draft with the selected layout. The public page does not change until you publish. Your current draft is kept as a new history entry.
history_restore_confirm: Restore this layout to the draft
history_restored: Draft restored from layout history. Public content is unchanged.
history_conflict: The draft changed. Reload the builder, then try restore again.
history_missing: That layout revision is no longer available.
library_blocked: Clear incompatible scenes, feeds, images, item fields or layout before choosing the theme section library.
confirm_library_change: Switch to the existing builder layout? Native-only facts, comparison and presentation options will be removed.
caption: Preview caption
illustration: Draw an illustrative interface in CSS
illustration_help: An illustration is not a real product screenshot. Supply a caption explaining this, and clear the image URL first.
label: Label
preset_create: Create draft and open the builder
preset_help: Creates a private draft with the section structure for this purpose. The hero uses your title; the other sections start empty and hidden until you write them. Nothing is published.
preset_error: The page could not be created. Check the purpose, title and language.
list_type_help: The directory lists and searches published items of this type in the page language (for example post). A type that is not public shows nothing.
form_slug_taken: Another published page already uses the form address “{slug}”. Choose a different slug, then publish again.
form_slug_help: Lowercase English letters, digits and dashes, up to 40. Entries are sent to /forms/ followed by this slug.
form_slug_required: The title has no English letters, so no slug was made from it. Type a slug, for example booking. Publishing waits until it is set.
form_slug_invalid: Use only lowercase English letters, digits and dashes, up to 40.
form_slug_reserved: The site already uses contact and comment. Choose another slug.
form_slug_repeated: Another form on this page uses this slug.
form_file_once: A form takes one file field.
field_name: Field name (used in entries and CSV)
field_name_required: The label has no English letters, so no name was made from it. Type a name, for example full_name. Publishing waits until it is set.
field_name_invalid: Use lowercase English letters, digits and underscores, up to 40. The name cannot start with an underscore or be website.
field_name_repeated: Another field of this form uses this name.
field_choices_limit: At most 20 choices. Lines after the 20th are ignored.
form_field_type_unknown: This field type is not supported. Choose one from the list.
task_entry_help: Links open real destinations. Search sends a GET request to a local page; it does not run tools, create sites or submit orders.
suggest_local_source: Local suggestions from the validated core component library. Text, links and media are retained.
suggest_ai_source: AI selected this option from the validated alternatives; it did not rewrite the content.
suggest_empty: No compatible alternative preserves all of this section’s fields. Keep it or edit the layout manually.
suggest_applied: Applied to the unsaved draft. Review and save to keep it; Undo is available. The public page is unchanged.
suggest_stale: The section changed. Request suggestions again before previewing or applying.
suggest_ai_disclosure: Only section type, layout, entry/image/link counts and allowed alternative IDs will be sent. No text, links, images or other page sections are sent. Destination:
suggest_ai_unavailable: AI is unavailable or not configured. Local suggestions remain usable; an administrator can review AI settings.
suggest_ai_invalid: AI did not select an allowed alternative. Use a local suggestion or retry.
suggest_invalid: The section is invalid or exceeds the 64 KiB suggestion limit. Use manual layout controls.
suggest_preview_notice: Suggestion preview only. The editor section and public page have not changed.
suggest_reason_scan: Compact rows make a longer collection easier to scan while retaining the entries.
suggest_reason_images: Give the existing images more prominence without changing their source or description.
suggest_reason_priority: Emphasize the first marked featured entry, or the first entry, with supporting entries alongside it.
suggest_reason_image_start: Place the image at the reading start; preserve text order on mobile.
suggest_reason_image_end: Place the image at the reading end while retaining the text and media.
suggest_reason_split: Separate the existing introduction and media into two clear regions.
suggest_reason_centered: Use a single centered introduction with the existing action and media.
suggest_reason_faq: Use a split question layout while keeping native expandable answers.
suggest_reason_choice: Present the existing destinations as task choices.
suggest_reason_service: Present the existing destinations as service rows with explanatory text.
suggest_ai_no_candidates: AI can only choose a compatible alternative; none preserves all fields for this section.
